key.name: monitor-mode
key.summary: Which monitors get an extra top bar
key.description: "all" adds a bar to every monitor except the primary one (which already has the system top bar). "custom" only adds bars to the monitors listed in enabled-monitors.

key.name: enabled-monitors
key.summary: Monitor connectors to add a bar to
key.description: List of monitor connector names (e.g. "DP-1", "HDMI-1") that get an extra bar when monitor-mode is "custom".

key.name: show-activities
key.summary: Show the Activities / workspaces button

key.name: show-workspace-dots
key.summary: Show workspace dots in the Activities button
key.description: When disabled, the Activities button shows a text label instead of workspace indicator dots.

key.name: show-date-menu
key.summary: Show the clock / calendar / notifications menu

key.name: show-quick-settings
key.summary: Show the Quick Settings menu

key.name: show-a11y
key.summary: Show the accessibility menu

key.name: show-keyboard
key.summary: Show the keyboard layout indicator

key.name: mirror-indicators
key.summary: Mirror indicators from other extensions
key.description: Show clickable copies of the icons other extensions add to the main top bar (app tray icons, clipboard managers, etc.). Their menus open on the monitor of the bar they were clicked on.

key.name: mirror-quick-settings
key.summary: Mirror Quick Settings toggles from other extensions
key.description: Show clickable copies of the toggles other extensions add to the main Quick Settings menu.

key.name: clock-position
key.summary: Position of the clock in the bar

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Screen edge for the extra bars

key.name: panel-height
key.summary: Bar height in pixels (0 = theme default)

key.name: custom-background
key.summary: Use a custom background color

key.name: background-color
key.summary: Custom background color (hex)

key.name: background-opacity
key.summary: Background opacity of the extra bars
key.description: 1.0 keeps the background fully opaque; lower values make the bar translucent.

key.name: hide-in-overview
key.summary: Hide the extra bars while the overview is open

key.name: hide-on-fullscreen
key.summary: Hide a bar when a window is fullscreen on its monitor

key.name: animate-fullscreen-bars
key.summary: Which bars slide in and out on fullscreen changes
key.description: Bars not covered by this setting hide instantly, like stock GNOME. "main" is the primary monitor's system top bar; "secondary" the bars this extension adds.

key.name: animation-duration-hide
key.summary: Slide-out duration in milliseconds

key.name: animation-duration-show
key.summary: Slide-in duration in milliseconds

key.name: animation-interpolation
key.summary: Easing curve for the slide animation

key.name: pressure-reveal
key.summary: Reveal a hidden bar by pushing the pointer against its screen edge

key.name: pressure-reveal-bars
key.summary: Which bars can be revealed by pointer pressure

key.name: pressure-threshold
key.summary: Pointer pressure (in pixels) needed to reveal a bar
key.description: How far the pointer must be pushed against the screen edge before the bar slides in. Higher values require a firmer shove.

key.name: pressure-timeout
key.summary: Time window in milliseconds for accumulating edge pressure
key.description: Pressure older than this is forgotten; slow drifts against the edge won't trigger the reveal.

key.name: reveal-hide-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds before a revealed bar hides again
key.description: Counted from when the pointer leaves the bar (a bar with an open menu stays visible).
